answer.answer: Mission Shakti is a comprehensive scheme with two sub-schemes: 'Sambal' for safety and security of women, and 'Samarthya' for empowerment of women [E02]. The Sambal sub-scheme includes One Stop Centres (OSCs), Women Helplines (WHLs), Beti Bachao Beti Padhao (BBBP), and a new component called Nari Adalat [E02]. The Samarthya sub-scheme includes Ujjwala, Swadhar Grehs, Working Women Hostels, National Creche Scheme, and PMMVY under ICDS, plus a new Gap Funding for Economic Empowerment component [E02]. The scheme's objective is to provide short-term and long-term services and information for holistic development and empowerment of all women and girls, including differently-abled, socially and economically marginalized and vulnerable groups [E02]. Implementation involves human resources at various levels with specific qualifications and safeguards [E01], institutional arrangements at central, state, and district levels [E01], and monitoring through a dedicated portal with geo-tagging of all supported institutions [E03].
